title: The Embalmer's Heretic Urn
logline: An orbital ossuary embalmer tasked with sealing an anonymous veteran's ashes in a consecrated vault discovers that the remains belong to the monastery's martyred heretic whose memory the abbot ordered erased.

roles.description: Chief preparator of the orbital ossuary; gentle, devout, and troubled by an agonizing crisis of monastic faith.
Lord prelate of the orbital monastery; regal, dogmatic, and dedicated to expelling all doctrinal contamination.
An aging outer-belt wanderer who carried her teacher's mortal ashes across five star systems.
A quiet zero-g sanctuary where generations of devout stationers are sealed in stone alcoves.
The high altar tomb overlooking the star where canonized saints are laid to rest.

public_situation: Monastic pilgrims assemble outside {role:orbital_ossuary_spire} as {role:archival_abbot} prepares to consecrate a new cathedral tier for honored church veterans.
private_truth: The ashes delivered for burial belong to the monastery's celebrated apostate theologian, whose peaceful final writings disprove the abbot's orthodox dogmas.

beats.public_change: Censer fumes drift through {role:orbital_ossuary_spire} as monastic acolytes inspect burial urns for canonical purity.

missions.reason: He pays an outside pilot to collect an uncataloged lead burial urn from a refugee freighter dock before liturgical inspection begins.
missions.private_fact: The urn carries a sealed scripture scroll written in the banned hand of the monastery's exiled founding thinker.

beats.public_change: {role:archival_abbot} posts inquisitorial notices ordering all unverified remains quarantined for forensic doctrinal testing.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to scan the monastery's historical martyr register to prove the abbot falsified the execution records thirty years ago.
missions.private_fact: The heretic did not die of illness in exile; he was poisoned by church bailiffs after refusing to recant his humanist sermons.

beats.public_change: Choirs begin the consecration litany as the abbot takes his seat upon the high altar dais of {role:consecrated_stellar_vault}.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to transport the urn into the stellar tomb before church censors seize and scatter the ashes in the reactor waste.
missions.private_fact: He knows that admitting the heretic's saintliness will invalidate thirty years of church decrees and split the monastic order.

player_choice.prompt: Holding the heretic's mortal remains and the proof of the abbot's poisoned purge, the pilot must decide whether to consecrate the urn, reveal the murder, or let orthodoxy burn the past.

options.label: Inter the ashes in the high stellar vault under the heretic's true name to force ecclesiastical reckoning
Deliver the urn to the disciple so the heretic's followers can carry his memory beyond the church
Surrender the urn to the abbot to preserve institutional tranquility and collect a heavy ecclesiastical tithe

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot unseals the heretic's name on the high altar.
resolutions.summary: {role:monastery_embalmer} unseals the heretic's name on the altar. Outraged acolytes force {role:archival_abbot}'s resignation, sparking deep doctrinal reform.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped place the ashes of a murdered church thinker into the high cathedral altar.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the urn to the disciple.
resolutions.summary: {role:heretic_disciple} departs with the urn. The heretic's peaceful teachings spread through rim settlements, while the monastery remains stagnant.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot carried a persecuted philosopher's ashes out of a hostile monastery.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot surrenders the urn to the abbot.
resolutions.summary: {role:archival_abbot} burns the scroll and deposits the ashes in an unmarked trench. The church hierarchy tightens its grip, rewarding the pilot with gold.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot assisted an authoritarian abbot in destroying the final testament of an ecclesiastical martyr.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the delivery.
resolutions.summary: Church inquisitors storm the embalming suite, casting the disputed urn into the station smelter. {role:monastery_embalmer} resigns his holy vows in silence.

loose_threads.detail: The monastic apothecary ledger lists recurring purchases of lethal neuro-spores routed through a commercial pharmaceutical shell.
The burial urn's ceramic lid carries an antique artisan trademark registered to a guild workshop destroyed forty years ago.

radio_hooks: Monastic council inaugurates new orbital reliquary spire amidst solemn bell tolls.
Station religious registry updates canonical index of approved theological treatises.
Pilgrim hostels report overcrowding near outer monastery transfer docks.

voice_direction.monastery_embalmer: Soft, solemn, and pauses frequently as if listening for distant bells. Speaks with painful reverence when handling remains.
voice_direction.archival_abbot: Resonant, imperious, and speaks in formal ecclesiastical cadence. Dismisses dissenting theological queries with polished condescension.
voice_direction.heretic_disciple: Haggard, resolute, and speaks with fierce, unadorned simplicity. Refuses all formal church honorifics.

title: The Stolen Ionic Shield
logline: An orbital shipyard engineer hires a pilot to test a revolutionary ionic radiation shield in deep pulsar space, hiding that her corporate employer stole the working prototype from a fired rigger collective.

roles.description: Senior propulsion tester for an orbital shipyard; brilliant, ambitious, and quietly sickened by corporate theft.
Spokesperson for the fired night-shift mechanic collective; grease-stained, defiant, and fighting for their stolen patent.
Vice-president of drydock development; slick, litigious, and rushing the shield to market to save his career.
A violently radioactive space corridor exposed to high pulsar radiation pulses.
The massive drydock slipway where capital freighters and cruisers are fitted.
The mutual-aid fraternity of night-shift dock welders and engine tuners.

public_situation: Shipyard stocks surge as executives unveil the prototype of an ionic pulsar shield capable of protecting ships in high radiation sectors.
private_truth: The shield was invented by an uncredited night-shift rigger collective over three years; shipyard management fired the entire team without severance to claim the patent.

beats.public_change: Promotional holos display shield test data as dock management installs armed security around {role:orbital_shipwright_slipway}.

missions.reason: She pays an outside pilot to mount the experimental ionic shield generator onto a test hull before company directors gather.
missions.private_fact: The generator's core housing contains the etched names of the six night-shift welders who built it by hand.

beats.public_change: {role:rigger_inventor} and blacklisted mechanics blockade the slipway fuel lines, threatening to sabotage power to the testing range.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to scan the executive patent docket terminals to verify whether the patent filing was backdated to pre-date the mechanics' dismissal.
missions.private_fact: The executive used falsified security breach reports to justify terminating the mechanics without intellectual property royalties.

beats.public_change: A massive pulsar flare hits the system, threatening unshielded berths across {role:pulsar_testing_range}.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to fly through the pulsar flare with the prototype shield to certify its deflection efficiency under real fire.
missions.private_fact: She knows the shield works flawlessly because the riggers' custom harmonic tuning prevents resonant overload.

beats.public_change: {role:shipyard_executive} prepares to broadcast the successful test results to regional patent syndicates from the central slipway.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to rush the original hand-drawn engineering logbooks to the station patent magistrate before the broadcast signs away their rights.
missions.private_fact: If the riggers win recognition, the collective plans to license the shield freely to all independent working ships across the sector.

player_choice.prompt: Holding the flawless test telemetry and the riggers' original handwritten design logs, the pilot must decide whether to return the patent to the workers, negotiate a corporate royalty settlement, or sell out to the executive.

options.label: Deliver the original logs to the patent magistrate to award the patent to the rigger collective
Force the executive to rehire the mechanics as salaried partners with lifetime royalties
Sell the original engineering logs to the executive to bury the riggers' claims forever

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the original design logs to the magistrate.
resolutions.summary: The magistrate awards the patent to {role:rigger_cooperative}. The riggers release the blueprints open-source, bankrupting {role:shipyard_executive}.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved an orbital shipyard stole a revolutionary pulsar shield from its own night-shift mechanics.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the executive into a royalty settlement.
resolutions.summary: {role:shipyard_executive} rehires the mechanics with permanent equity to prevent a public scandal. The shield goes into mass production, benefiting all parties.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot forced a corporate shipyard to give night-shift welders ownership of their prototype shield.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the engineering logs to the executive.
resolutions.summary: {role:shipyard_executive} burns the logs and patents the shield under his own name. The mechanics are blacklisted, while corporate stock triples.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped a corporate shipyard executive erase evidence of stolen worker patents.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the test run.
resolutions.summary: Protesting mechanics damage the testing slipway with plasma cutters. The prototype generator shorts out, and management cancels the program in disgust.

loose_threads.detail: A regional patent licensing bank registered advanced royalties for an unlisted shield device four days before the mechanics were fired.
The generator's cooling vanes carry micro-laser weld initials matching employee badges deactivated by station security.

radio_hooks: Shipyard consortia tout impending commercial rollout of revolutionary pulsar shield.
Labor boards report surge in intellectual property disputes filed by shipyard mechanics.
Pulsar radiation storms prompt temporary travel warnings across inner perimeter lanes.

voice_direction.testing_engineer: Methodical, crisp, and speaks with scientific enthusiasm that turns tense and defensive when corporate ethics are broached.
voice_direction.rigger_inventor: Blunt, raspy from welding fumes, and fiercely articulate about technical mechanics. Refuses corporate euphemisms.
voice_direction.shipyard_executive: Effortlessly smooth, rapid, and speaks exclusively in investment portfolio jargon. Discards human concerns as sentimentality.

title: The Veteran's Hospital Transit
logline: A decommissioned naval hospital ship carrying hundreds of disabled veterans is barred from docking across regional gates, hiding that the vessel holds the classified wartime survey charts proving regional peace borders were drawn on fraudulent maps.

roles.description: Commanding officer of the aging hospital vessel; proud, weary, and shielding his wounded crew from bureaucratic malice.
Border administrator coordinating gate closures; polished, evasive, and taking orders from territorial treaty barons.
Chief physician aboard the hospital ship; blunt, exhausted, and desperately counting remaining life-support reserves.
A heavily armed border interdiction cruiser blocking gate approaches.
The administrative gateway controlling transit permits across the three-system cluster.
A peaceful decommissioned naval station in the outer system willing to harbor the hospital ship.
The fraternal convoy of wounded soldiers, nurses, and support crews seeking permanent shelter.
The governing council of regional planetary oligarchs who partitioned the border systems after the war.

public_situation: Regional gate authorities bar a decommissioned naval hospital vessel from docking across three star systems, citing expired quarantine certificates.
private_truth: The hospital vessel's archive vault contains the original unredacted armistice boundary surveys, proving current corporate border tariffs are legally fraudulent.

beats.public_change: Customs beacons broadcast yellow quarantine warnings around {role:central_gate_customs_spire} as the hospital ship slows its burn.

missions.reason: She pays an outside pilot to haul dense ferrite plates from local belts to patch the hospital ship's aging ward hulls before port inspection.
missions.private_fact: The customs authority intentionally delayed the vessel's docking permit to force it to run out of environmental scrubbers.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to purchase certified municipal transit clearance stamps to challenge the border closure before the magistrate.
missions.private_fact: He knows the regional governors fear the archive vault because it proves their mining concessions lie in neutral space.

beats.public_change: Border cruisers shadow the hospital vessel as it limps toward a neighboring system's refit docks.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to intercept a treaty surveillance drone and recover its encrypted telemetry intercept before the convoy is tracked.
missions.private_fact: The treaty consortium has authorized border cruisers to disable the hospital ship's communications array.

beats.public_change: {role:regional_customs_director} issues a total gate interdiction order, trapping the hospital ship in an uninhabited transition sector.

missions.reason: She pays the pilot to scan the customs director's private comms relay to prove the quarantine was ordered by corporate treaty barons.
missions.private_fact: The director was promised a luxury retirement seat on the treaty board for ensuring the hospital ship never docks.

beats.public_change: {role:treaty_patrol_cruiser} corners the hospital ship outside {role:frontier_sanctuary_berth}, powering weapons to board and seize the archives.

missions.reason: He begs the pilot to disable the patrol cruiser's weapons array before it breaches the hospital hull and confiscates the survey records.
missions.private_fact: The cruiser captain hails offering millions in corporate bond credits if the pilot helps scuttle the archive vault.

player_choice.prompt: With the treaty cruiser disabled and the fraudulent border surveys secure, the pilot must decide whether to publish the charts, escort the veterans to sanctuary, or sell out to the treaty barons.

options.label: Broadcast the unredacted boundary surveys across regional networks to expose the corrupt armistice borders
Escort the hospital vessel into sanctuary berth while keeping the charts sealed for veteran peace
Deliver the boundary archives to the treaty consortium for a massive corporate payoff

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the unredacted boundary surveys across the network.
resolutions.summary: The fraudulent border surveys leak across three systems. Corrupt tariffs collapse, {role:regional_customs_director} is dismissed, and the veterans are granted permanent honors.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broadcast wartime surveys proving three systems of trade tariffs were built on faked borders.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot escorts the hospital ship safely to sanctuary dock.
resolutions.summary: The hospital ship docks safely at {role:frontier_sanctuary_berth}. The veterans receive peaceful retirement care, while the charts remain a quiet leverage chip.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defended a stranded hospital ship across regional gates to secure a haven for wounded veterans.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the boundary surveys to the treaty consortium.
resolutions.summary: Treaty agents purge the hospital vault. The fraudulent borders stand, while {role:hospital_commodore} is stripped of rank and his patients scattered across work camps.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot assisted corrupt treaty barons in destroying the historical archives of a naval hospital ship.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the convoy.
resolutions.summary: Life support fails in the dark sector. The hospital ship drifts into deep space as an abandoned ghost vessel while regional governors cover up the tragedy.

loose_threads.detail: A regional customs bank records massive tariff rebates paid to private corporate cartels under a secret post-war armistice annex.
The archive case carries lead security seals stamped with the crest of a naval cartographic bureau dissolved thirty years ago.

radio_hooks: Regional customs authority turns away naval hospital vessel citing expired quarantine permits.
Veterans welfare societies stage protests outside border gate clearance pylons.
Treaty commission assures public that frontier boundary markers remain permanently fixed.

voice_direction.hospital_commodore: Low, gravelly, and speaks with rigid naval bearing. Pauses slightly to mask the physical pain of old wounds.
voice_direction.regional_customs_director: Polished, breezy, and speaks with practiced diplomatic charm that turns icy and dismissive when defied.
voice_direction.fleet_medical_surgeon: Harried, blunt, and cuts off administrative pleasantries to demand concrete medicine and fuel counts.
